fig_framework_overview: System architecture of the EC8A-Sentinel visual-statutory election audit pipeline, showing raw 3-4 MB INEC IReV Form EC8A smartphone capture ingestion into 4-bit quantized Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct with dynamic-resolution NaViT tokenization, followed by the Electoral Act Section 64(4) Collation Sum Invariant Gate (intercepting 95.65% of VLM transcription errors) and the Two-Tier Section 51(2) Clerical-Slip Disentanglement Solver.
fig_benchmark_comparison: Grouped bar chart comparing handwritten field extraction accuracy (Exact Match %) and error/hallucination rate (Hallucination %) of EC8A-Sentinel (Qwen2.5-VL-7B 4-bit on Osun-EC8A-250, achieving 98.77% exact match and 1.23% hallucination) against seven published laboratory, medical form, and wild handwritten table baselines.
fig_party_and_error_taxonomy: Dual-panel analysis on the Osun-EC8A-250 benchmark (3,750 party cells across 250 sheets) showing (left) per-party Exact Match (%) across all 15 political parties and (right) failure mode decomposition of the 46 total misread cells alongside their 95.65% (44/46) autonomous interception rate via the Section 64(4) Collation Sum Gate.
fig_statutory_reconciliation: Local Government Area (LGA) statutory audit breakdown across ATAKUMOSA EAST (75 sheets), ATAKUMOSA WEST (75 sheets), AYEDAADE (100 sheets), and the full Osun-EC8A-250 corpus (250 sheets), illustrating how Two-Tier Section 51(2) reconciliation partitions 58 raw over-voting flags (23.20%) into 38 Class I Benign Clerical Slips saved (65.52% of flags) and 20 Class II Unresolved Over-Voting Anomalies (8.00% of sheets).
